failures.task: Summarise the electricity expense for my budget; omit the dental observations.
failures.text:
My brother, Casen Yule, offered to accompany me to the dentist. One tooth has been sensitive to cold drinks for five days, but I have not noticed any swelling. The discomfort stops within a minute after the drink. I want to describe those observations clearly without guessing the cause.

My monthly electricity bill is 76 euros and I want to compare plans.
